unsupported.fact: NM->>WR: a package name or version to print
unsupported.why: The package field is sent by the 'a descriptor or path name' participant and comes after the name step. The original has 'a package name or version' as a separate, independent input (F --> FC) and makes no claim that names and fields come from one source or in any order.

changed.fact: else a char falls outside the simple set
changed.original: S{"non-empty and every char in the simple set?"} -->|no| Q
changed.why: The original 'no' branch also covers the empty name. write_name (sym.rs:373) backtick-quotes an empty name too, so the rewrite's else label drops that case and narrows the condition.
